title: Sialkot-Kharian Motorway Construction Facing Further Delays
excerpt: The Sialkot-Kharian Motorway project is facing additional delays, with only 20 percent of the construction work completed so far.
body_html:
The construction of the Sialkot-Kharian Motorway, also known as the M-12, is experiencing further delays. Work on the 69-kilometer infrastructure project remains behind schedule, according to recent updates.

Reports indicate that only 20 percent of the total construction work on the motorway has been completed to date.
